title: Oversize Openings and Expedite Handling Charges — Plant Schedule
content:
**Schedule.** For Factory Production Orders built on an expedited schedule, an oversize handling add-on is charged on the oversize openings recorded at the most recent completed measure visit of the window contract the order builds:

| Oversize openings at that measure visit | Add-on |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 30 dollars each |
| 1 or 2 | 20 dollars each |
| none | nothing |

The add-on is added to the per-unit charge of the expedite before that sum is compared with the class minimum expedite fee.

## Records read

The count is the oversize opening count recorded on the Window Replacement Contracts measure visits of the contract — openings measured above the series' standard united-inch bracket — taken from the most recent visit whose outcome is completed. Earlier visits, and visits not completed, are not read.

## Edges of the bands (hypothetical)

- 3 oversize openings: 3 at 30 dollars, 90.00.
- 2 oversize openings: 2 at 20 dollars, 40.00.
- An earlier completed visit recorded 4 oversize openings and the most recent completed visit recorded 1: the add-on is 20.00.
